relationships.subject: hADSCs + green light therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: Quantitative analysis revealed that TNF-α, IL-1β, and CD68 expression in the combined treatment group were markedly lower than those in single-treatment cohorts (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: hADSCs + green light therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: the combined treatment promoted microglia autophagy, evidenced by increased Beclin1 and LC3B expression and decreased P62 in microglia.

relationships.subject: 3-methyladenine
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings confirm the effective inhibition of microglial autophagy recovery by 3MA.

key_findings: hADSCs plus green light synergistically reduce spinal inflammation and pain after SCI, partly through microglial autophagy.
